name: build
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd build

name: contracts
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd --filter @graphgoblin/contracts test:coverage --maxWorkers=2

name: engine
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd --filter @graphgoblin/engine test:coverage --maxWorkers=2

name: recovery-process
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd exec node --test docs/qa/2026-10-22-wp-d1-321-qa/recovery-process.integration.mjs

name: restart
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd --filter @graphgoblin/api exec vitest run src/script-restart.test.ts --config=../../docs/qa/2026-10-22-wp-d1-321-qa/api.config.mts --maxWorkers=1

name: edge
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd --filter @graphgoblin/web exec playwright test -c ../../docs/qa/2026-10-22-wp-d1-321-qa/playwright.script-recovery.config.ts

name: mcp
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd --filter @graphgoblin/mcp exec vitest run src/describe.test.ts src/tools.test.ts --maxWorkers=1

name: typecheck
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd typecheck

name: infrastructure
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd --filter @graphgoblin/infrastructure test:coverage --config=../../docs/qa/2026-10-22-wp-d1-321-qa/infrastructure.config.mts --maxWorkers=1 --coverage.reportOnFailure

name: lint
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd lint

name: layers
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd check:layers

name: deps
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd check:deps

name: docs
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd check:docs

name: tokens
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd check:tokens

name: native-isolated
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd --filter @graphgoblin/infrastructure exec vitest run src/process/scripts.test.ts --config=../../docs/qa/2026-10-22-wp-d1-321-qa/infrastructure.config.mts -t kills and closes a real process --maxWorkers=1

name: client-types
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd exec tsc -p docs/qa/2026-10-22-wp-d1-321-qa/client-config.json

name: native-other-isolated
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd --filter @graphgoblin/infrastructure exec vitest run src/process/scripts.test.ts src/claude/process.test.ts src/adversarial.test.ts --config=../../docs/qa/2026-10-22-wp-d1-321-qa/infrastructure.config.mts -t ProcessScripts abort kills|kills on deadline and output overflow|does not spawn for an already aborted|kills the descendant|kills the process tree on timeout|kills the process when the signal aborts --maxWorkers=1

name: api
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd --filter @graphgoblin/api test:coverage --config=../../docs/qa/2026-10-22-wp-d1-321-qa/api.config.mts --maxWorkers=1 --coverage.reportOnFailure

name: child-zero-isolated
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd --filter @graphgoblin/api exec vitest run src/child-creation-restart.test.ts --config=../../docs/qa/2026-10-22-wp-d1-321-qa/api.config.mts -t kill 0ms --maxWorkers=1

name: web
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd --filter @graphgoblin/web test:coverage --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 --coverage.reportOnFailure

name: format
steps: From worktree root with Node 22 first on PATH: pnpm.cmd format:check
